description: Every published intergovernmental internal trade commitment against each of the 14 governments: done, in progress, missed or not committed, with deadlines and the official source per cell. Filter by jurisdiction for one government's record, or pass a commitment id for its full row.

commitment.description: Commitment id from a previous scoreboard result.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code (CA = federal, BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, QC, NB, NS, PE, NL, YT, NT, NU) or its name.
